title: Design: Tiers list columns, numbers, badges and row buttons
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, so the list shows a new active row.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses, archived, so the list shows an archived row.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps: 1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The label above the list reads the number of active tiers followed by "active tiers".
  • The columns read #, Tier, Customers, Matrices and Status, in that order.
  • Numbers are plain text centred under the # (no pill), and the archived row shows a dash instead of a number.
  • Active rows show a green Active badge; the archived row shows a gray Archived badge.
  • Each row ends with a pencil and a three-dot button; New Tier is a blue button at the right with a three-dot button left of it.
  • Fonts, spacing and alignment match picture 2.2 compared with the design picture at 100% zoom.
  • Default's row has no Default badge (its name says it).
